_comment: INTERNAL categories: what a self-improvement to the INSTRUMENT can be about. The 24 axes in config/target_config.json describe the WORLD the system measures; these describe the system itself. A spec must choose a domain first (internal or external) and then one or more categories FROM THAT DOMAIN. Forcing an internal fix -- a JSON parser that breaks on a model's output -- onto a world axis is malformed, and a model asked to do it wanders: five live runs on one such problem produced four different world axes (TECHNOLOGY_AI, TECHNOLOGY_INFRA, DEEP_TIME_RISKS, GOAL_PROGRESS), every one of them real and every one of them a guess.
_rule: one line of meaning per category, so the prompt can show the model what each one is without a second file to look up

categories.reliability: the system keeps working when an input, a model or a service misbehaves -- retries, fallbacks, timeouts, malformed responses
categories.instrumentation: the system can see what it did -- logs, traces, provenance stamps, records that let a human reconstruct a run
categories.correctness: the system computes the right answer -- parsing, arithmetic, control flow, a result that matches what the code claims
categories.safety: the system cannot do harm it was not authorised to do -- guards, ceilings, refusals, limits on what a change may touch
categories.performance: the system does the same work with less time, memory or budget, without changing the answer
